Throughout those years, he's remained as honest as the day is long.
Never once has he sacrificed an ounce of integrity in service to our state and nation.

Mike's long been known to be forthright on the issues of the day, convicted in thought, and a consistent messenger regarding America's role, at home and abroad, as a powerful force for good," said **Governor Eric Holcomb**.
"I am proud to endorse Mike Pence for President.
He is a proven, conservative leader who will utilize his experiences as a Congressman, Governor, and Vice President to rebuild America.
